Definition: gift of God; zabdiel, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Zabdiel is named twice in the Bible, and the passages here are 1 Chronicles 27:2; Nehemiah 11:14. In 1 Chronicles 27:2 we read, "Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel..." The same name belongs to more than one man, and Nehemiah 11:14 names another of them.
TheologicalSignificance: Zabdiel is recorded once and kept forever, and I take comfort in that. His name stands in the record, and that is enough for me.
